output.text: Our shared workspace balances privacy and collaboration through thoughtful desk placement. Each person has a private corner for focused work. Frequently used stationery is kept in a shared tray, accessible to all. Drawing materials are positioned on the window side to take advantage of natural light. A clear center area remains unobstructed, enabling easy exchange of large sheets. This layout supports both individual focus and teamwork. The shared tray, window side, and clear center are essential to our design, ensuring efficiency and consideration for everyone.
